title: Progress for Path Follow Node does not update position/globalPosition
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.3 official release and 4.4-dev7
-  Not reproducible in 4.3 dev 2 and behind. 
-  Did not test versions between 4.3 and 4.3 dev 2

### System information

Windows 11 ulkan API 1.3.280 - Forward+ - Using Vulkan Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090

### Issue description

```gdscript 
extends PathFollow3D

func _ready():
	var i = 10;
	
	for n in i:
		progress = (100/i) * n;
		
		self.progress_ratio = progress
		print(self.progress)
		print(self.transform)
		
	
	pass 
```


Expected behavior: As you update the progress of a path, it will update it's transform:

Check a path follow node's position
Change the position
Check the position again
